name: Plaza Mary and Joseph
demographics: Plaza Mary and Joseph primarily serves cross-border dental tourists, predominantly seniors and retirees aged 55+ from the United States and Canada seeking affordable healthcare. The visitor base consists of middle-income households without comprehensive dental insurance, drawn to the 50-70% cost savings compared to North American prices. Daily traffic includes approximately 5,000 visitors to the Los Algodones area, with the shopping center catering to this transient population alongside local residents of Vicente Guerrero, a small border community with a service-oriented economy built around medical tourism.
description: Plaza Mary and Joseph serves as a gateway commercial center in Vicente Guerrero, Baja California, strategically located in Los Algodones—internationally recognized as 'Molar City' and the world's premier dental tourism destination. This shopping center operates within a unique border town ecosystem where over 300 certified dental clinics attract approximately 5,000 daily visitors, primarily American and Canadian seniors seeking world-class dental care at 50-70% savings compared to prices back home. The plaza's location just 7 miles from Yuma, Arizona makes it easily accessible for cross-border patients who walk across the international border for same-day dental appointments, implants, crowns, and full mouth restorations. Operating Monday through Saturday from 8:00 AM to 9:00 PM, with Sunday appointments available, the center provides essential services and amenities for the steady stream of medical tourists who have made Los Algodones a trusted destination for over 12 years. The shopping center benefits from its position in a compact, senior-friendly town where English-speaking services, modern facilities, and international sterilization standards have created a welcoming environment for North American visitors seeking both quality healthcare and significant cost savings.
summary: Plaza Mary and Joseph is a commercial center in Los Algodones, Baja California, known as 'Molar City'—the world's leading dental tourism destination. Located just 7 miles from Yuma, Arizona, the plaza serves thousands of daily cross-border visitors, primarily American and Canadian seniors seeking affordable, high-quality dental care at 50-70% savings.
